description: This Java class 'CompressedUpdate' extends 'AbstractIndelUpdate' and manages compressed data updates, including creating empty updates, replacing all data for a subscriber, and generating snapshots of current state.

classes.name: CompressedUpdate
classes.description: A final class representing updates to compressed DData, supporting operations like creating empty updates, replacing all data, and snapshotting current state.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns an immutable empty update.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Creates a new update that replaces all data with the provided set of inserts.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current update's inserts and deletes.
